This indicates a potential regulatory relationship where Acteoside may influence the expression or activity of cyclin B1 through its interaction with the Asialoglycoprotein receptor 2, possibly by modulating signaling pathways that are critical for cell cycle progression. The integration of these findings highlights a possible role for Acteoside in the control of cyclin B1 expression, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated.
